mapper.sql: a.achievement_id AS "achievementId", a.management_no AS "managementNo", a.teacher_user_id AS "teacherUserId", u.employee_no AS "employeeNo", u.login_id AS "teacherName", a.organization_code AS "organizationCode", a.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear", a.management_item_code AS "managementItemCode", a.achievement_date AS "achievementDate", a.title, a.attachment_ref AS "attachmentRef", a.achievement_status AS "achievementStatus", a.created_at AS "createdAt", a.updated_at AS "updatedAt", a.created_by AS "createdBy", a.updated_by AS "updatedBy"
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM education_achievements a JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id
ORDER BY a.achievement_date DESC, a.achievement_id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{pageOffset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM education_achievements a JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id

SELECT FROM education_achievements a JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id WHERE a.achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND a.achievement_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND a.deleted_yn = 'N' FOR UPDATE OF a
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{managementItemCode}, achievement_date = #{achievementDate}, title = #{title}, attachment_ref = #{attachmentRef}, achievement_status = #{achievementStatus}, updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND deleted_yn = 'N' AND achievement_status IN ('DRAFT', 'DEPARTMENT_REJECTED', 'CERTIFICATION_REJECTED')
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.management_item_code AS "code", m.management_item_name AS "name", e.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear" FROM evaluation_management_items m JOIN evaluation_elements e ON e.element_id = m.element_id JOIN evaluation_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id JOIN evaluation_areas a ON a.area_id = i.area_id WHERE a.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND m.active_yn = 'Y' AND e.active_yn = 'Y' AND i.active_yn = 'Y' AND a.active_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY e.evaluation_year DESC, m.management_item_code

SELECT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.effective_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND (m.effective_end_date IS NULL OR m.effective_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY m.effective_start_date DESC, m.mapping_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT u.user_id FROM users u WHERE u.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.system_use_yn = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_roles r WHERE r.user_id = u.user_id AND r.role_code = 'R01' AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.valid_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND (r.valid_end_date IS NULL OR r.valid_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u CROSS JOIN (SELECT #{teacherUserId}::bigint AS teacher_user_id, #{organizationCode}::text AS organization_code) a WHERE u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM function_permissions p WHERE p.screen_id = 'SCR-EMPLOYMENT-RATE-ACHIEVEMENT' AND p.function_type = #{functionType} AND p.permission_allowed = 'ALLOW' AND p.role_code IN #{role}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation_management_items m JOIN evaluation_elements e ON e.element_id = m.element_id JOIN evaluation_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id JOIN evaluation_areas a ON a.area_id = i.area_id WHERE m.management_item_code = #{managementItemCode} AND e.evaluation_year = #{evaluationYear} AND a.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND m.active_yn = 'Y' AND e.active_yn = 'Y' AND i.active_yn = 'Y' AND a.active_yn = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM excel_upload_files f WHERE f.file_token = #{attachmentRef} AND f.uploader_user_id = #{teacherUserId} AND f.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT j.batch_job_id AS "jobId", j.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear", j.requester_user_id AS "requesterUserId", j.job_status AS "jobStatus", j.action_type AS "actionType", j.total_count AS "totalCount", j.processed_count AS "processedCount", j.unprocessed_count AS "unprocessedCount", j.target_condition_json::text AS "targetConditionJson" FROM employment_rate_batch_jobs j WHERE j.batch_job_id = #{jobId}

SELECT i.target_user_id AS "targetUserId", i.achievement_id AS "achievementId", i.processed_yn AS "processedYn", i.unprocessed_reason AS "unprocessedReason" FROM employment_rate_batch_job_items i WHERE i.batch_job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY i.batch_job_item_id

SELECT t.template_id FROM excel_upload_templates t WHERE t.business_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.system_use_yn = 'Y' AND t.effective_date <= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY t.effective_date DESC, t.template_version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT r.required_column FROM excel_upload_template_rules r WHERE r.template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY r.column_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO excel_upload_staging_rows (staging_row_id, upload_id, row_number, row_payload, validation_status) VALUES (#{rowId}, #{uploadId}, #{rowNumber}, CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb), #{validationStatus})

INSERT INTO excel_upload_errors ( error_id, upload_id, row_number, column_name, input_value, error_code, error_reason, correction_guide ) VALUES (#{errorId}, #{uploadId}, #{rowNumber}, 'row', #{inputValue}, 'INVALID_ROW', #{reason}, '입력값을 확인하세요.')

INSERT INTO excel_upload_histories ( upload_id, total_count, success_count, error_count, saved_count, processor_user_id ) VALUES (#{uploadId}, #{totalCount}, #{successCount}, #{errorCount}, 0, #{actorId})
mapper.select: SELECT f.upload_id AS "uploadId", f.uploader_user_id AS "uploaderUserId", f.validation_status AS "validationStatus", f.file_token AS "fileToken" FROM excel_upload_files f WHERE f.upload_id = #{uploadId} AND f.business_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' FOR UPDATE
SELECT s.row_number AS "rowNumber", s.row_payload::text AS "payload", s.validation_status AS "validationStatus" FROM excel_upload_staging_rows s WHERE s.upload_id = #{uploadId} ORDER BY s.row_number
SELECT e.row_number AS "rowNumber", e.column_name AS "columnName", e.error_reason AS "errorReason" FROM excel_upload_errors e WHERE e.upload_id = #{uploadId} ORDER BY e.row_number, e.column_name

SELECT f.upload_id AS "uploadId", f.original_file_name AS "originalFileName", f.uploaded_at AS "uploadedAt", f.validation_status AS "validationStatus", h.total_count AS "totalCount", h.success_count AS "successCount", h.error_count AS "errorCount", h.saved_count AS "savedCount" FROM excel_upload_files f JOIN excel_upload_histories h ON h.upload_id = f.upload_id WHERE f.business_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND f.uploader_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.uploaded_at DESC, f.upload_id
